verdict.rationale: No first-party bulk action is documented, such as multi-select triage or batch fix requests. Bulk work is only implied: the GitHub App install lets you pick several repositories at once, and the v1 API, OpenAPI spec and MCP tools expose triage, scan triggering and schedule management that a user or agent could script across many findings or repos. Missing for 10: a documented native bulk-operation feature (bulk triage, bulk ticketing, bulk fix PRs), bulk or batch API endpoints, and hands-on corroboration of acting on many items at once.
